title: Forms of Linear Equations: Point-Slope, Slope-Intercept and Standard Form
seo_title: Algebra 1 Point-Slope and Standard Form Worksheets: Writing Linear Equations, Parallel and Perpendicular Lines (Free, Answer Key)

key_big: y = mx + b, y − y₁ = m(x − x₁) and Ax + By = C all describe the same line.
key_sub: Parallel: same slope. Perpendicular: negative reciprocal slopes.
body_html:
How it works

A line can be written in three common forms:

  • Slope-intercept: y = mx + b (slope m, y-intercept b)
  • Point-slope: y − y1 = m(x − x1) (through the point (x1, y1))
  • Standard: Ax + By = C (integers, A > 0); find intercepts by setting x or y to 0

Parallel lines have the same slope. Perpendicular lines have slopes that are negative reciprocals (their product is −1).

Example

Write the line through (2, 5) with slope 3 in point-slope and slope-intercept form.

y − 5 = 3(x − 2).

y = 3x − 6 + 5.

Answer: y = 3x − 1

Example

Find the intercepts of 2x + 3y = 12.

y = 0: x = 6.

x = 0: y = 4.

Answer: (6, 0) and (0, 4)

Example

Find the slope of a line perpendicular to y = −4x + 1.

Flip −4 to get −¼, then change the sign.

Answer: 14

Common mistakes

  • Sign errors in point-slope form: through (−3, 2) it is y − 2 = m(x + 3).
  • Using the y-value of the point as b. Substitute to find b.
  • Giving a perpendicular line the same slope, or just the reciprocal without changing the sign.
  • Mixing up the intercepts: the x-intercept is where y = 0.

faq.a: y − y₁ = m(x − x₁), where m is the slope and (x₁, y₁) is a point on the line.

faq.q: How do you convert standard form to slope-intercept form?
faq.a: Solve for y: move the x-term to the other side, then divide every term by the coefficient of y.

faq.q: How do you find the slope of a perpendicular line?
faq.a: Take the negative reciprocal: flip the fraction and change the sign. Perpendicular to slope 2/3 is −3/2.

faq.q: How do you find the intercepts from standard form?
faq.a: Set y = 0 and solve for x to get the x-intercept; set x = 0 and solve for y to get the y-intercept.

items.e: Point-slope form is y − y1 = m(x − x1). Put in m = 3, x1 = −1 and y1 = −4: y + 4 = 3(x + 1).

items.q: Find the x- and y-intercepts of 5x − 4y = 40.
items.e: Let y = 0: 5x = 40, so x = 8. Let x = 0: −4y = 40, so y = −10. x-intercept 8, y-intercept −10.

items.q: Find the x- and y-intercepts of 6x − 2y = 18.
items.e: Let y = 0: 6x = 18, so x = 3. Let x = 0: −2y = 18, so y = −9. x-intercept 3, y-intercept −9.

items.q: Find the x- and y-intercepts of −3x − 4y = 36.
items.e: Let y = 0: −3x = 36, so x = −12. Let x = 0: −4y = 36, so y = −9. x-intercept −12, y-intercept −9.

items.q: Write 2x + 4y = 24 in slope-intercept form.
items.e: Subtract 2x from both sides, then divide every term by 4: y = −12x + 6.

items.q: Find the x- and y-intercepts of −2x + 5y = −10.

items.q: Write the equation of the line perpendicular to y = −2x − 4 that passes through (−4, −1).
items.e: The slope is 12 (negative reciprocal of −2). Then −1 = 12(−4) + b, so b = 1: y = 12x + 1.

items.q: What is the slope of a line parallel to y = 34x − 2?
items.e: Parallel lines have the same slope: 34.

items.q: Write the equation of the line perpendicular to y = 2x − 6 that passes through (−2, −1).
items.e: The slope is −12 (negative reciprocal of 2). Then −1 = −12(−2) + b, so b = −2: y = −12x − 2.

items.q: What is the slope of a line perpendicular to y = 3x − 2?
items.e: Perpendicular slopes are negative reciprocals: flip 3 and change the sign to get −13.

items.q: A plumber charges $85 for a 1-hour job and $145 for a 3-hour job. Which equation gives the cost C for h hours?
A candle is 24 cm tall after 2 hours and 15 cm tall after 5 hours. Which equation gives its height h after t hours?
In the candle model h = −3t + 30, what does 30 mean?
c: The candle was 30 cm tall at the start
items.e: The y-intercept is the value when t = 0: the starting height.

items.q: A taxi ride costs $3.50 plus $2.25 per mile. Which equation in slope-intercept form gives the cost C for m miles?
items.e: The rate per mile is the slope and the starting fee is the y-intercept: C = 2.25m + 3.50.

items.q: Adult tickets cost $8 and child tickets cost $5. A school spends $400. Which standard-form equation models this?
items.e: Cost of adults plus cost of children equals the total: 8a + 5c = 400.

items.q: For 8a + 5c = 400, what does the a-intercept 50 mean?
c: The school can buy 50 adult tickets and no child tickets
items.e: The a-intercept is where c = 0: 50 adult tickets and no child tickets.

items.q: A gym had 120 members in month 1 and 180 members in month 4. Write a point-slope equation using the point (1, 120).
Which line is parallel to y = 4x − 7?
items.e: Same slope (4), different intercept: y = 4x + 2.

items.q: Which line is perpendicular to y = 2x + 1?
items.e: The negative reciprocal of 2 is −½: y = −½x + 3.

items.q: What is the slope of the line 3x + 4y = 12?
items.e: 4y = −3x + 12, so y = −¾x + 3. The slope is −¾.

items.q: Which equation is in standard form?
items.e: Standard form is Ax + By = C: 2x − 5y = 10.

items.q: A line has point-slope equation y + 3 = 2(x − 5). Which point is on the line?
items.e: y − y1 = m(x − x1) with y + 3 = y − (−3): the point is (5, −3).

items.q: Write y + 3 = 2(x − 5) in slope-intercept form.
items.e: Distribute: y + 3 = 2x − 10, then subtract 3: y = 2x − 13.

items.q: A water tank holds 500 gallons and drains at 20 gallons per minute. Which equation gives the water W after t minutes?
items.e: Start at 500 and lose 20 each minute: W = −20t + 500.

items.q: When does the tank above (W = −20t + 500) become empty?
Lines with slopes 23 and −32 are…
items.e: 23 × (−32) = −1, so they are perpendicular.

items.q: Are y = 3x + 2 and 6x − 2y = 8 parallel?
c: No, they have the same intercept
items.e: 6x − 2y = 8 gives y = 3x − 4. Both have slope 3: parallel.

items.q: A phone costs $40 a month on a plan, and the total after 6 months is $330. Which equation gives the total T after m months?
What is the equation of the horizontal line through (4, −2)?
items.e: A horizontal line has slope 0, so every point has y = −2: y = −2.

items.q: What is the equation of the vertical line through (4, −2)?
items.e: A vertical line has every point with x = 4: x = 4. Its slope is undefined.
